title: Edit your model
tryWithClaude: Ask Claude: write a short description for each measure in Sales.

steps.say: Pick a measure in the Model tree. Its properties open beside it.
Queries runs DAX and shows the numbers, so you can test a measure before you keep it.
Find and replace changes many names or descriptions at once.
AI instructions tell Copilot and your assistant how to read this model.
Every edit lands in History. Undo takes back any line.
